title: The prop stamped onto its page

members.role: the chart is the world - the page holds, its lines drawn and tagged, before anything is added to it
the named thing is added to the world bare - a catalogued cutout, no card, a DIRECT match for the word only
it comes down on the word: the mark takes the page's biggest free room, rests off-square, and the ring hugs it

does: A named thing lands INTO the chart's world on its word: the prop is sized to the page's biggest free room, stamped down off-square with the ring just outside it, and leaves with its own exit.
